race.title: PRL Group Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: BRADY HARTSFIELD and Huntin Boots stand out on bumper form. John McConnell's charge is preferred given the antics of the latter on his hurdling debut, while Loadstone could be the pick of the Joseph O'Brien newcomers. Baila Conmigo and Rocky Alfonso complete the shortlist. BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE) HUNTIN BOOTS (IRE) LOADSTONE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Brady Hartsfield (6/4), Huntin Boots (15/8), Baila Conmigo (7/1), Rocky Alfonso (7/1), Loadstone (8/1), Moonlight Quest (12/1), Cracking Cloud (16/1), Morris From Mayo (33/1), Quinlan (33/1), Storm Bresie (66/1), Devine Genius (200/1), Lady Luck (250/1)
